Your namespaces

    Share a namespace

    A ticket is a capability, not a link to a server — see SPEC.md §3.4/§3.6. Anyone holding it can sync this namespace directly with this node; there's nothing else granting or revoking it. A Write ticket is a shared secret with no per-holder revocation — anyone who ever sees it, sees it forever (SPEC.md §6 item 12). Read-only defaults to selected on purpose: only pick Write for someone you're handing this to directly, never for anything you're about to post, print, or paste somewhere public.

    Inspector

    Every raw entry currently synced into a namespace — no per-record-type code, generic across whatever's in there (NodeProfile, a governance Proposal, anything added later). A debugging view, not a feature; see dump_all in namespace.rs.
